items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: the leader of this company was a pianist, the director, was Claude Hopkins.

ctx.x: Was another company came over, called the "Black People". And the reason I mention them is because the leader of this company was a pianist, the director, was Claude Hopkins. And along with Claude Hopkins, one of the great singers of the company, was a great artist in the company was two. Maude deForrest and another little girl named Josephine Baker. And Josephine Baker was in -- she sat in our theater at the Palace -- no, the Theater am Zoo, it was. And she listened to our show and all. From that day went on…
So all of a sudden you had competition. In Europe, you had another black show.
